payload.text:
> **Build a responsive web app for a personality-style quiz based on a physical card-based experience.**
>
> The physical version contains the full questions.
> The digital version will show **ONLY answer options (A/B)**.
>
> Users arrive via QR code.

---

### 1️⃣ PURPOSE

Create a visually rich, minimal-yet-premium quiz app where:

* Users enter their **Name + Email**
* Data is saved to **Google Sheets**
* Users answer 4 questions (A/B format)
* System calculates a personality archetype
* Displays a **results card**
* Theme: **Luxury Poker Cards / Playing Cards**

---

### 2️⃣ USER FLOW

#### Landing Page (QR Entry Page)

Design:

* Dark luxury background (black / charcoal / deep green)
* Subtle poker-table texture
* Animated playing cards

Content:

* Title: “Your Journey Begins”
* Subtitle: “Draw your cards. Discover your path.”
* Input fields:

  * Name (required)
  * Email (required)
* Button: **“Shuffle & Start”**

On submit:
→ Save name + email to Google Sheet
→ Start quiz

---

#### Quiz Pages (One Question at a Time)

Total: 4 Questions
Only show **Answer Options (no questions text)**

Each question appears as:

Two poker-style cards:

🂡 Card A
🂱 Card B

Each card contains:

* Elegant typography
* Short poetic answer
* Subtle hover animation
* Click = selection

---

##### Question Structure (Use Exactly This)

**Q1 – Pace**
A: “A stroll. Open to serendipity.”
B: “A chase. Everything, everywhere.”

**Q2 – People**
A: “Just myself. One trusted soul.”
B: “Strangers. Stories. Locals.”

**Q3 – Immersion**
A: “Rivers. Meadows. Nature.”
B: “Rituals. Stories. Culture.”

**Q4 – Growth**
A: “Inner reflection.”
B: “Curiosity & exploration.”

---

After each answer:
→ Animate card flip
→ Auto advance

Progress indicator: 1/4 → 4/4

---

### 3️⃣ SCORING SYSTEM

Each answer maps to letters:

Q1: A = S, B = A
Q2: A = I, B = E
Q3: A = N, B = P
Q4: A = X, B = Z

Combine into 4-letter code:

Example:
S I N X = “The Pilgrim”

---

### 4️⃣ ARCHETYPE LOGIC

Create a lookup object that maps:

```
SINX → The Pilgrim  
SINZ → The Arctic Monk  
SIPX → The Curator  
SIPZ → The Listener  
SENX → The Palm Tree  
SENZ → The Romantic  
SEPX → The Wandering Artisan  
SEPZ → The Poet  
AINX → The Albatross  
AINZ → The Earth Whisperer  
AIPX → The Unhurried  
AIPZ → The Treasure Hunter  
AENX → The Driftwood  
AENZ → The Ranger  
AEPX → The Serendipitous  
AEPZ → The Insatiable
```

Each archetype contains:

* Name
* Essence paragraph
* Destination
* Description

(Use content from attached PDF but remove Nod branding)

---

### 5️⃣ RESULTS PAGE (Final Card Reveal)

Design:

* Full-screen poker card
* Flip animation
* Gold border
* Glassmorphism overlay

Content:

* Archetype Name
* 4-letter Code
* Essence Text
* Destination
* CTA Button

Button:
“Save My Card”
(download image)

Optional:
“Share My Card”

---

### 6️⃣ GOOGLE SHEETS INTEGRATION

On completion, send:

| Name | Email | Q1 | Q2 | Q3 | Q4 | Code | Archetype | Timestamp |

Use:

* Google Apps Script OR
* Sheet API OR
* Zapier webhook

Must work without backend maintenance.

---

### 7️⃣ DESIGN SYSTEM

Theme: **Luxury Poker / Casino / Tarot Hybrid**

Colors:

* Jet Black
* Deep Emerald
* Burgundy
* Antique Gold
* Ivory White

Typography:

* Display: Playfair / Cormorant / Cinzel
* Body: Inter / Lato

UI Style:

* Rounded cards
* Soft shadows
* Subtle glow
* No harsh borders
* No clutter

Animation:

* Card shuffle
* Card flip
* Fade transitions
* Hover glow

Mood:
“Mysterious, premium, poetic, intimate”

Not cold-minimal. Not flashy. Balanced.

---

### 8️⃣ TECH REQUIREMENTS

Build using:

* React / Next.js OR Vanilla JS
* Mobile-first
* Fast loading
* No external ads
* SEO optimized landing

Features:

* Local state management
* Error validation
* Email format check
* Prevent duplicate submission

---

### 9️⃣ BRAND CLEANUP

Remove ALL references to:

* The Nod
* Nod branding
* Nod CTA
* Nod checkbox

Keep only:

* Quiz logic
* Archetypes
* Results

Brand should feel independent.

---

### 10️⃣ BONUS (If Possible)

Add:

* Admin dashboard
* CSV export
* Analytics
* Completion rate tracking
* Heatmap of answers

---

## OUTPUT EXPECTATION

Generate:

1. Full frontend code
2. Google Sheet connector
3. Deployment steps
4. Environment setup
5. README

---

**Conceptualizing the Web App**

I'm currently fleshing out the core concept. The plan involves a landing page with name/email capture, a concise four-question quiz using A/B choices, followed by archetype calculation and a final results page that mimics a high-end poker card design. Crucially, I'm integrating this with Google Sheets for data handling.


**Refining the Visual Design**

I'm now zeroing in on the visual aesthetic. I've chosen a luxury poker/casino/tarot theme with a dark color palette of gold, emerald, and burgundy. Cinzel/Playfair for display fonts and Inter/Lato for body text provide a suitable typography blend. Component-wise, I'm aiming for animated cards, glassmorphism, gold borders, and subtle glows. The app flow is established: landing, quiz, and result. Also, I've outlined the component breakdown of the app and how Google sheets will be integrated. I'm building out the four question quiz and am considering how to use destination information in the result.

**Refining Destination Integration**

The goal is to visually enrich the personality quiz by associating each destination with a relevant image. The next step will be working on integrating that information with the app's rendering so destinations are displayed with appropriate visuals.


**Revising Layout Specifications**

I'm now overhauling the layout of the quiz results card. It should present the Archetype Name and Description first. Following that, there will be the "Your Destination" section with an image and relevant context. I'm removing the 4-letter code. Finally, I'm integrating a "Would you like us to take you here?" prompt with Yes/No options. I'm also reviewing the fonts to get them as close to licensed versions as possible with Google Fonts and system fonts if necessary, and will be specific about their class names.


**Evaluating Font and Images**

I'm prioritizing humanist sans-serifs with a flare, similar to `Optima`, or `Bodoni Moda`. Simultaneously, I've gathered image URLs to pair with each destination.


**Finalizing Asset Integration**

I've just added image URLs for several destinations within the `ARCHETYPES` constant in `constants.ts`. I am adding descriptions along with the image URL for richer presentation of each destination in the quiz results. I'm also preparing to update the `index.html` file with Google Font alternatives to the licensed fonts, assuming the user will replace them with local fonts. I am also adding `imageUrl` to the `Archetype` type within `types.ts`. I also am going to redesign the landing page button, and overhaul the ResultsPage layout, prioritizing a clear display of the Archetype Name and Essence, followed by Destination details.
